title: Learning record (stage 8)
description: The story's contribution to the system-wide learning index. The only artifact that survives the workspace into system memory. Categories drive routing in tools/update_learning.py; *_proposal entries are flagged for operator review between stories and never auto-applied.

consumed_by: tools/update_learning.py — appends to LEARNING_RECORD.md, routes 'failure' to known-failure-modes.md, 'pattern' to known-good-patterns.md, prints 'files to patch' report from *_proposal entries
operator (between stories) — promotes proposals into playbook / prompts / templates / approved-examples
next story's fresh Claude — reads the resulting known-failure-modes.md and known-good-patterns.md before stages 1, 3, 4, 5

story_type.description: Mirrors 01_understanding.story_type, or '?' if the story was rejected at stage 1 before classification.

outcome.description: How the story closed. published: stage-7 decision='publish' and quality>=4. iterated: decision='iterate' (revisions still pending). scrapped: decision='scrap' or stage-5 hit the 3-iteration cap. rejected: stage-2 status='insufficient' (never rendered). skipped: operator declined render after stage 5 cleared (no stage-7 scrap, no 3-iteration cap).

subjective_quality.description: Mirror of stage-7 subjective_quality, or null if the story did not reach stage 7 (e.g. outcome=rejected).

entries.description: 1–6 entries. Each is load-bearing or it does not belong here. Generic entries ('be careful with numbers') are anti-patterns — see prompts/07-learning-extractor.md.

category.description: Drives routing in update_learning.py. Two-strike rule: rule_proposal only on the second occurrence of a class; first occurrence becomes prompt_proposal instead.

summary.description: One sentence stating what happened. Specific to this story; not a generic principle.

evidence.description: Artifact path and field/line. 'Felt off' is not evidence. 'stories/215/05_pre-render-critique.json:warns[2]' is.

future_check.description: A test that would catch this next time. Name a file, regex, or threshold. 'Be careful' is not a check.

links.description: Existing entries in known-failure-modes.md or known-good-patterns.md to link rather than duplicate.
